title: Gate run: a real ticks epic through ticfac run-epic with kill and restart at the three points
description: The Phase 1 gate (SPEC §12). Pick a small real epic in the ticks repository (coordinate with the operator for which; a 2-3 tick epic is enough), run it with ticfac run-epic and a claude or codex runner from a laptop, and kill the reconciler after dispatch, after collection and before closure, restarting each time from a FRESH CLONE. Record: the .ticfac/runs/<id>/ directory on the integration branch, the ticfac/run-<id> tag, the PR the run opened, and a report RESULT-<this-tick>.md with timings, cost if metered, every restart and what the reconciler adopted. This report is the evidence that closes ticks-tracker tick 421 (final review of 4ik) — say so in the report. Commit RESULT even though no source changed — the report is the deliverable.
notes:
2026-09-08 10:43 - [human] Approved by the operator: run ticks epic cia (uhw + uqe wave 1, t62 wave 2, review brp, closeout glo) through ticfac run-epic with runner=claude; live ticks repo pushes, PR and spend authorised. go
2026-09-08 10:48 - Gate run started 2026-09-08 08:45Z: epic cia in ticks, runner claude, run-id gate-cia, binaries from epic/qeu 19995af. Cut 1 (after dispatch) landed at checkpoint seq 3 (uhw dispatched, attempt 1); run 2 restarted from fresh clone2 at 08:47Z. Workaround in effect: reconciler run with cwd = ticfac checkout because the tk client locates the manifest from the repo root (filed as u65).
2026-09-08 10:54 - Cut 2 (after collection) at checkpoint seq 7 (uhw integrated, state gating) 08:49Z; run 3 from clone3 re-ran the gate and was cut before 'tk close uhw' at seq 12 (state publishing, evidence gate-uhw-1-{go,pi-runner} on origin, uhw still open in the tracker — no false close); run 4 from clone4 started 08:54Z to completion. Still exactly one attempt marker (attempts/1.json).
2026-09-08 11:17 - Run 4 (clone4, no cuts) FAILED at t62: the worker read its blockers uhw/uqe as status open in .tick/issues (origin/epic/cia and origin/main) and answered BLOCKED — the reconciler's tk claim/note/close writes were left uncommitted in the clone4 checkout on main and never pushed. Real Phase 1 defect (tracker writes not durable); filed as cgx (P1). Evidence: checkpoint seq 30 state failed, attempts 1-3, evidence gate-uhw-1-*, gate-uqe-2-*; clone4 working tree dirty on .tick/issues/{uhw,uqe,t62}.json. Gate run resumes after the fix with the three cuts repeated on t62.
acceptance_criteria: The real epic is closed in ticks with a merged PR opened by ticfac; three restarts recorded with zero duplicate attempts and zero false closes, verified from the .ticfac/ record; the tag exists; the report is committed.
